claims.text: The authors aimed to investigate the effect of hierarchical position embeddings on summarization performance using CNN/DailyMail as a test dataset.
The performance improvements on CNN/DailyMail were small, suggesting that the hierarchical structure of the documents is less pronounced compared to other datasets like PubMed.
Ablation studies indicated that the hierarchical position information contributed to the model's performance, although the results on CNN/DailyMail were not as substantial as on other datasets.
